title: Fix three bugs in a Rust CharFreq module
description: Fix bugs in CharFreq: char_freq increments by 2 instead of 1, most_frequent always returns None, unique_chars returns byte length instead of unique character count.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. char_freq: change `*count += 2` to `*count += 1`
2. most_frequent: replace the bare `None` return with `freq.into_iter().max_by_key(|&(_, v)| v).map(|(c, _)| c)`
3. unique_chars: return `char_freq(s).len()` instead of `s.len()`
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
